title: Document Store with Boolean Predicate Search
description_html:
Design an in-memory document service that stores documents and queries them with boolean predicate expressions over tokens.

APIs

  • InsertDoc(filename, content) — store a document. filename is a unique id; content is treated as a set of tokens.
  • CheckContains(filename, predicate) -> bool — does the named document satisfy the predicate?
  • GetAllFiles(predicate) -> List[str] — all filenames that satisfy the predicate.

Predicate semantics

A bare token evaluates to whether the document contains it. Operators: && (AND), || (OR), and () parentheses. Precedence: parentheses highest, then && binds tighter than ||. So a && b || c means (a && b) || c.

Examples

Insert(f1, "a b"); CheckContains(f1, "a")              => true
Insert(f1, "a b"); CheckContains(f1, "c")              => false
Insert(f2, "c");   CheckContains(f2, "a && b || c")     => true
Insert(f3, "a");   CheckContains(f3, "a && (b || c)")   => false
Insert(f1,"a b"),(f2,"c"),(f3,"a"); GetAllFiles("a && b || c") => ["f1","f2"]

Scale

Up to 1e5 documents, 1e3 tokens/doc, 1e3 tokens/predicate.

See Notes for the approach and related problems (Refer).
